prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1219; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other driver was changing lanes, reporting pain and swelling in the right knee. The mechanism described is consistent with the injury observed, and the clinical picture fits what would be expected from a force of this kind. Examination findings and imaging clearly confirm the knee injury, including soft tissue involvement that accounts for the patient's symptoms. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain in the same area, which resolved completely with no lasting limitation and did not affect the present evaluation. Care proceeded over 14 visits and followed a typical course, with frequency decreasing as strength, range of motion, and pain improved. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated charges. At the most recent visit the patient was progressing well and was discharged to a self-directed home exercise program.
